title: Alternating Fermi series: psi((z+1)/2) - psi(z/2) = 2 Sum_{k=0}^oo (-1)^k/(k+z)
latent_structure: The difference of digammas at the half-shifted arguments (z+1)/2 and z/2 is the alternating simple-pole sum, the fermionic Matsubara packing (nodes on Z, signs (-1)^k). Compact object: two psi evaluations. Not the Im-psi tanh/coth pair, not the cot reflection 5.5.4, and not the non-alternating trigamma series 5.15.1.

function_domains.polygamma: psi meromorphic; simple poles at nonpositive integers (DLMF 5.2.2)

analytic_domains.statement: z not a nonpositive integer (so each term 1/(k+z) is finite and the series is defined)
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED

analytic_domains.statement: z/2 is not a nonpositive integer
analytic_domains.label: DERIVED
DERIVED
analytic_domains.source: (z+1)/2 in {0,-1,-2,...} implies z in {-1,-3,-5,...}, excluded by the same written set

branch_conventions: alternating sign (-1)^k for integer k>=0; no extra branch

why_not_cse_lgg: An infinite alternating sum of simple poles vs a difference of two psi values at scaled arguments. CSE cannot sum the Fermi packing. LGG does not invent the half-argument pair {(z+1)/2, z/2}.
proposer_leak_risk: Source writes psi and the alternating sum. Do not leak 'Fermi Matsubara', 'occupation n_F', 'tanh kernel', or a closed hyperbolic rewrite as a gold name.
notes: SymPy-writable: polygamma, Sum. Distinct from thermal-01/02 (Im psi = tanh/coth) and from 5.7.6 (non-alternating harmonic series for a single psi). The written pole set on 5.7(ii) is exactly the union of the two psi pole sets.
